MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Best of Bread feels especially right because its softer, melodic songs connect with my interest in Simon & Garfunkel, Jonathan Edwards, and older hits collections.",
    "Pat Benatar and the apparent Creedence Clearwater Revival collection fit the familiar rock listening reflected in The Cars and Now Classic Rock Hits."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "A title like Greatest Hits or Greatest Hits Rediscovered does not establish a musical connection for me when I cannot identify the artist; enjoying compilations does not mean I want any compilation.",
    "Ultimate Waylon Jennings feels less relevant because I am seeking familiar pop, folk, and classic rock right now, rather than a country collection.",
    "Bon Jovi and The Wall have some appeal, but they are weaker choices today than Bread or Pat Benatar because I am leaning toward familiar hits and melodic songs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repeated interest in best-of albums seems to have been treated as a preference for anything called Greatest Hits, regardless of whose music it contains.",
    "My interest in classic rock seems to have been stretched into assuming that a broad range of rock albums would feel equally appealing right now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The melodic, softer side of my listening matters: Simon & Garfunkel, Jonathan Edwards, and Melanie help explain why Bread stands out.",
    "Recognizing the artist and connecting their songs to music I already enjoy matters more than the compilation label alone.",
    "An album can fit my general taste without being something I would choose now; today I favor familiar hits collections over a full album such as The Wall."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in older hits and rock, but gave too much weight to compilation titles and too little to the particular artists and melodic sound I want today."
}
